name: Pohang-si

queries.query: Pohang-si official cadastral parcel map GIS Republic of Korea
queries.result: Search identified the official Pohang spatial-information portal, the Korean Ministry of Land cadastral WMS/WFS catalog, and K-GeoP. The local portal exposes a public cadastral map layer, but no anonymous safe parcel ID-plus-geometry response was verified.

queries.query: 포항시 공식 지적도 토지정보 GIS 필지 지도
queries.result: 검색 결과는 포항시 공식 공간정보포털을 확인했다. 포털에는 연속지적도 레이어와 지번 검색 UI가 공개되어 있으나, 익명 안전 필드(id와 geometry) 응답은 확인하지 못했다.

registryBasis: The official Pohang city spatial-information portal is a local city GIS custodian and visibly exposes 연속지적도 (continuous cadastral map), parcel-number search, and local map services.

source.name: Pohang City Spatial Information Portal
source.serviceType: Official local GIS portal with continuous cadastral-map layer and parcel search
source.geometryType: Polygon layer indicated by the map service; feature response not verified
source.outputCrs: EPSG:5187 in the portal configuration; no parcel response retained

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: The portal presents Pohang city map services and cadastral/parcel search controls.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: Local portal configuration exposed a WMS gateway and EPSG:5187 map configuration. Bounded anonymous requests did not yield a safe parcel feature response, so citywide parcel coverage is not verified.

technicalBlocker: The official HTML/config exposed the local WMS gateway and a POST route /phgis/system/map/get-feature-by-addr-query.lm used after parcel-address search, but no safe anonymous parcel ID-plus-geometry response was available from bounded requests. WMS capability requests timed out. No login, credentials, CAPTCHA bypass, private token, or unsafe fields were used.
remainingUncertainty: The public viewer may return parcel geometry through an interactive parcel search or a request requiring a valid parcel address context. A zero/timeout result is not evidence of citywide absence.
nextStep: Hold runtime integration. A later researcher may qualify an anonymous first-party parcel endpoint by independently verifying native identity, schema, CRS, and safe ID-plus-geometry output.
pointBasis: Exact immutable WUP 2025 point; not shifted to force a parcel hit.
